locator: Figure 2B, bottom two printed rows, journal p. 38721. Figure 3A gives the nominal osmometer precision.
preparation: One POPC giant unilamellar vesicle weakly adhered to a supported bilayer by 0.4% PEG. Successive bath steps reached equilibrium in approximately one hour each. Reduced volume is enclosed volume divided by the spherical volume at the measured membrane area.
mapping: Use the prepared 25 mM sucrose as 25 mOsm/L and take the reference vesicle to be isotonic and spherical. A second prediction uses only the first measured pair to set the effective trapped solute per spherical volume. The four later measurements are withheld from that estimate.
uncertainty: The labels report one vesicle and are rounded to two decimals in reduced volume. The paper supplies no point-specific geometry uncertainty for this series. The 21-vesicle analysis in Figure 3 is a separate aggregate context.
